concern.source_query: How robust is this ACT policy when the target object mass changes?
concern.sub_aspect: Effect of target object mass variation on policy performance
concern.hypothesis: The ACT policy will successfully click the bell regardless of changes in the target object's mass.
concern.task_intent: Click the bell as the invariant base action and goal.
concern.requested_variation: Change the mass of the target object incrementally while keeping all other factors constant.
concern.measurement_need: Observe whether the bell is successfully clicked across different target object masses.
